definitions.gloss: tone-deaf; unable to sing in tune
definitions.explanation: A person who cannot distinguish or reproduce musical pitch accurately. Composed of 音 (sound, tone) + 痴 (foolish, lacking sense). The original and most common meaning.

definitions.gloss: having no sense of ~; being hopeless at ~
definitions.explanation: Used with a prefix to indicate a lack of ability or awareness in a particular area. A productive suffix pattern in modern Japanese, applied to directions, machines, fashion, and other domains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{音痴|おんち}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦カラオケ→カラオケ：05080_karaoke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm tone-deaf, so I'm not good at karaoke.

examples.japanese: {音痴|おんち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦カラオケ→カラオケ：05080_karaoke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are karaoke songs that even tone-deaf people can enjoy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音痴|おんち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{余計|よけい}→余計：04090_yokei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。
examples.english: When I sing next to someone who sings well, my tone-deafness stands out even more.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧{音痴|おんち}だ。
examples.english: He has no sense of direction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧{音痴|おんち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I'm hopeless with technology and can't figure out my phone's settings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧{音痴|おんち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a sport that even someone as unathletic as me can enjoy.

notes:
USAGE:
The suffix pattern ～{音痴|おんち} is very productive in casual Japanese. Common combinations include:
- ⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧{音痴|おんち} (no sense of direction — the most common extended use)
- ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧{音痴|おんち} (hopeless with machines/technology)
- ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧{音痴|おんち} (unathletic, having no coordination)
- {味|あじ}{音痴|おんち} (having no sense of taste)

Note that while {音痴|おんち} can be used about oneself self-deprecatingly, calling someone else {音痴|おんち} directly can be rude.
